verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.factory.ai (HTTP 200), described as documentation for 'the agent-native software development platform' with a page index. Doc pages are also served as raw Markdown (.md URLs), and a machine-readable openapi.json is published, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on using llms.txt or the .md docs with agents, no evidence of an llms-full.txt variant, no independent hands-on corroboration.
